notes.title: Update to 1.0.5 to keep playing with your friends!
notes.content:
Hello Trials players!

We are updating the full Knight Squad 2 with a Lengendary Update today, adding more modes and characters you'll encounter while playing online.

Make sure to update to 1.0.5 if you wish to keep playing with your friends who own the full game.

Stay Awesome!

----

Here's what you can expect from the 1.0.5 Update :

Changes:
- While playing online, it is now possible to report players.
- It is no longer possible to edit the name of your online room.
- It is now possible to send the devs your logs to help in reporting bugs and issues.

Tweaks / Fixes:
- Fixed an issue that rendered a player invincible.
- Fixed an issue caused by joining two online rooms in a row.
- Fixed an issue causing a player to explode at the start of a round in Battle Royale.
- Slightly improved the overall performance of the game.

notes.title: Update to 1.0.4 and keep the party going!
notes.content:
Good morrow Trials players!

Just in time for Knight Squad 2's first month anniversary 🎂 we are releasing a big update to the full game.

We have not forgotten you, knights in training, most of the quality of life improvement from that update also apply to Knight Squad 2 Trials. Make sure to update to 1.0.4 if you wish to keep playing with your friends who own the full game.

If you haven't already, check out Knight Squad 2 to read more about the full content:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660/Knight_Squad_2/]Knight Squad 2[/url]

We hope you'll enjoy it and don't forget to join our Discord to chat with us and find fellow players.

Stay Awesome!

----

Here's what you can expect from the 1.0.4 Update :

Serial Kamikaze!
You can now pick up a Kamikaze while under the effect of Kamikaze to reset it

Features:
- Added action to promote someone to be the host in the knight selection UI.
- Added option to allow keyboard and mouse to be a separate player.
- Added option to make announcer texts smaller.

Tweaks:
- When playing without bots, a leaving player will no longer be taken over by the AI. They will be removed from the game.
- If no enemy player is left when playing without bots, the players will be brought back to the lobby.
- Added a UI to let players know they are waiting for the host to choose the map options.
- Added game mode description tooltip for non-host waiting players.
- Changed the sort order of lobbies to show them by best region -> password status -> in game status -> player count
- Added power up spawn speed in the variants UI visualizer

Fixes:
- Fixed 32:9 aspect ratio (that is one crazy big screen)
- Fixed an issue where the local player would pull an Xbox One wireless dongle disconnecting multiple controllers at once.

notes.title: The full Knight Squad 2 is now available!
notes.content:
Good morrow fair gents!

The full version of Knight Squad 2 is now available on Steam! You can now unlock all the knights, all the game modes and all the maps.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660/Knight_Squad_2/]Knight Squad 2[/url]

If you are enjoying Knight Squad 2 Trials and you want to keep it at that, it's all fine. The Trials is not going away, we want people to use it to join their friends for free and have a good time.

Please take a moment to leave a Steam Review and join the Discord community!

[url=discord.gg/chainsawesome]Chainsawesome Discord[/url]

Thank you for your interest in our games.

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Knight Squad 2 Trials is available today!
notes.content:
Good morrow fair squires!

You have stumbled upon the brand new page for Knight Squad 2 Trials. KS2T, as we like to call it, is a free-to-play battle-royale preview of our upcoming game Knight Squad 2.

It’s way more than just a demo or a prologue though. In Knight Squad 2 Trials, you can play 1 mode ( Battle Royale ) and 3 maps online with your friends starting today. Once the full game releases on April 14th, however, you will get to play with people who own Knight Squad 2 no matter what platform they are playing on and experience all of the 13 game modes and the 97 maps.

That being said, we’re confident that Knight Squad 2 Trials and all its gameplay variations have more than enough content for you and your friends to have a ton of fun for free.

Find other players on [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url]
Let us know your thoughts in the forums and leave a review if you’d like!

Stay Awesome!
